title: Rarities (US album)
content:
The Beatles’ albums in order – complete list! » Rarities (US album)

Recorded: 1962-1969
Producer: George Martin

Released: 24 March 1980

Tracklisting

‘Love Me Do’
‘Misery’
‘There’s A Place’
‘Sie Liebt Dich’
‘And I Love Her’
‘Help!’
‘I’m Only Sleeping’
‘I Am The Walrus’
‘Penny Lane’
‘Helter Skelter’
‘Don’t Pass Me By’
‘The Inner Light’
‘Across The Universe’
‘You Know My Name (Look Up The Number)’
Sgt Pepper inner groove

Rarities was a compilation album released in North America in 1980. It is not to be confused with the UK album of the same name.

The compilation mostly contained recordings that had not been issued on Capitol Records or Apple releases, as well as alternative versions of various songs.

As well as North America, Rarities was released in several other countries including Australia, Canada, France, Japan, and New Zealand.

The rare tracks included:

  • The stereo mix of ‘And I Love Her’ with a six-bar ending
  • The mono mix of ‘Help!’ with alternative vocals
  • A new edit of ‘I Am The Walrus’ with a six-beat intro and an extra bar before the “yellow matter custard” line
  • ‘Penny Lane’ with an extra piccolo trumpet flourish at the end
  • The runout groove of the Sgt Pepper album

Other tracks included mono or stereo mixes that were unavailable or hard to come by in North America.
